verdict.rationale: Heap documents a server-side Bulk Track endpoint that accepts an `events` array of up to 1000 events per request, alongside a server-side track API for custom events. That gives developers a first-party bulk-ingestion path they could use to load exported event data. Nothing shows it is meant for or supports backfilling historical events, so it only partly delivers the story. Missing for 10: evidence that historical timestamps/backfill are accepted, a documented importer or migration path from other analytics tools or file exports, and any independent or hands-on confirmation of bulk historical imports.
